visible.title: Great tires
visible.body: Had the old nitto terra grapplers so I went for the ridge grapplers. Solid tires, love the fact that it gives you 2 mounting options based on how aggressive you want your sidewall to look.

visible.body: Great tires on and off the road, no road noise super sticky to the road always has great traction

visible.body: Everything looks awesome, love wheel and tires. Thank you!

visible.title: Nitro tires the best
visible.body: I really love how my gmc sierra 2024 2500hd drive like nothing happened

visible.author: Bryant
visible.title: Very adorable
visible.body: Work truck needed a new set of wheels, these are working out great. They are driving nice and smooth. They are quiet

visible.author: CourtlandT
visible.title: The Best Tires
visible.body: I live in Oklahoma we have to deal with mud rocks clay snow and ice. I run these daily on my 2018 Chevy Silverado. I drive 81 miles each way for work and they dont make any cabin noise to deal with even with the windows down. These tire work phenomenally good at clearing the treads so they are ready for clean bite. I just ran them at 20 psi on the K-Trail for a 31 mile trail and bearly had a tire slip. I do really recommend the E Rated tires for the 10ply to help protect against punctures. The only time I've had with slipping was on black ice bit that a given. On snow they worked out great on snow covered roads.
visible.product: NITTO Ridge Grappler A/T Tire (34" - LT305/70R17)

visible.author: Anthony
visible.title: Great
visible.body: Looks amazing and drives smoothly would recommend if you’re looking for a aggressive look
visible.product: NITTO Ridge Grappler A/T Tire (33" - LT285/60R20)

visible.author: Jeh941
visible.title: Fit good. Look great.
visible.body: Tires roll smooth on road. Less road noise and handle well. Definitely worth the extra money

visible.author: Joshua
visible.title: Nitto Ridge Grappler A/T’s
visible.body: Great looking tires. Smooth ride quality and easy to balance. Not sure if it’s the tires or just my recent luck. I’ve had these tires for about a year now and have had 3 nail punctures. These are the first Nitto Ridge Grapplers I’ve owned and never had a flat before putting these on. Overall reviews of the tire are great, and the reason why I went with them in the first place.

visible.author: Tywater
visible.title: Don’t forget 12 PLY
visible.body: You will get more than it calls for on the miles if you will pay the extra money. Lots of cuts in the tire so you can easily maintain your miles from the naked eye. Ice 2024 no issue. Tires sling and eat mud up. Rocks at about 30psi feels like a caddy even on a 6inch RC lift

low_same_part_other_truck.author: JakeDom
low_same_part_other_truck.title: Damaged wheel
low_same_part_other_truck.body: Tires are great but American trucks damaged my wheel while mounting the tires and then fought with me for 5 days over a partial refund for the damage they caused. I highly recommend not ordering wheels and tires from them
